remainingLimitations: Worktree-root resolution and CLI stage-state derivation rely on the `git` binary (already required by the SCM/CI); if `git` is absent the create/stage-aware paths fail closed rather than degrade.

Stage-aware enforcement runs in CI where trusted base/head SHAs are provided by the GitHub event; the pure transition function is unit-tested, and the CLI derives states from Git blobs. Local `validate` without base/head SHAs still enforces single-root/forbidden/workflow rules but not cross-commit stage transitions.

Research-JSON structural validation enforces governed top-level collections/objects (compatible with the proven OKX shape); deep field-level semantics remain the responsibility of the source-truth review and validation stages.
